title: Hematocrit–serum-protein coupling does not establish incremental pulse-pressure prediction across NHANES recruitment datasets
abstract: A hematocrit × serum-total-protein product did not establish incremental contemporaneous pulse-pressure prediction beyond flexible conventional predictors in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer (4,884 source;4,560 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.005821 mmHg², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.290368,0.558559].
